name: Emmy Noether Programme
amount: Funds to lead an independent junior research group (group leader position, staff, consumables, equipment, travel; modular budget)
other_rules: Normally up to 4 years after the doctorate with at least 2 years of postdoc experience
applicants from abroad must commit to continuing their career in Germany (letter of intent)
not eligible if already qualified for a professorship (habilitation), a positively evaluated junior professor, or already funded for an independent group by a comparable programme
notes: Proposals accepted any time; decisions take about 8 months. Any discipline.
